capabilities_done: F-R56-5: toc::line_of finds the blank line of a paragraph with no glyph, by Line.paragraph as place_markers and footnotes::locate read it. An index mark (generate_index, generate_index_contract) and a cross-reference destination (<pageNum/>, paragraph and text anchor) there answer the page composition places them on; a marker's derived value reads the same line

Found by the table, same function: a blank line starts where the next paragraph starts, and line_of took it for that paragraph's line. A heading, mark or destination after a blank line read the blank line's page, and a paragraph overset right after a placed blank line read as placed. An empty span now holds no byte, so both answer their own line (a_blank_line_is_not_the_line_of_the_paragraph_after_it, a_paragraph_overset_after_a_placed_blank_line_is_overset, consecutive_blank_lines_keep_their_own_pages). This also moves a running-text occurrence after a blank line to its true page
A scoped index range ending in a blank paragraph ends on that paragraph's page; it read as overset and took the story's last placed page (a_scoped_range_ending_in_a_blank_paragraph_ends_on_its_page)

F-R56-9: one reason per mapped heading left out, in one order at both TOC generators: hidden (its line on a hidden layer, include_hidden off, whatever it holds), then overset (no placed line, include_overset off, text unread), then no_text (derived text empty or only white space, placed or not, marker or not; DerivedText::no_text). Empty, marker-only, spaces-only and U+2028-only headings give no entry with include_overset on or off

Every omission counted: generate_toc gains GeneratedStory.omitted (TocOmitted {overset, hidden, no_text}), equal to the contract's omitted_overset, omitted_hidden, omitted_no_text in every row of the table; before it counted none

Running text unchanged on purpose: a blank styled paragraph stays no occurrence and does not take the place of the heading before it; running.rs untouched, reading toc::page_of, the line of text (a_blank_styled_paragraph_is_no_running_text_occurrence)

Consumers: an index entry from a blank line composes and exports to PDF with its Type glyphs (longdoc_pdf an_index_entry_from_a_mark_on_a_blank_line_exports); a white-space heading leaves the TOC and the PDF outline, no blank bookmark (a_white_space_heading_leaves_the_outline_and_is_counted); both tables hold through native Type (derived_text_native_type)

Hostile input: lookups are a binary search per frame instead of a walk over every line; a document of 65,536 empty paragraphs (Limits::default().max_paragraphs), every paragraph a mark and a heading, answers within the suite's timeout; one paragraph more is refused as budget_exceeded (v4_02_a_document_of_only_empty_paragraphs_at_the_limits_stays_bounded). No new per-call allocation beyond the existing lines of the byte's paragraph

spec_basis.STU-LAY-044: Tables of contents MUST be style-driven.
STU-LAY-148: `include_hidden` | boolean | Include entries from text on hidden layers.

The generate command takes a TOC style, a replace-existing flag, an optional book, a place point and an INCLUDE-OVERSET flag; Studio MUST expose the overset flag, because a TOC generated from a document with overset text otherwise silently omits entries.
`remove_forced_line_break` | boolean | Strip forced breaks from captured entry text.
spec_basis.STU-LAY-045: Indexing MUST build a topic/subtopic hierarchy through inserted index marks, with sort-by overrides, per-reference page-range scoping and cross-reference forms.
spec_basis.STU-LAY-047: Cross-references MUST insert references to paragraphs or named text anchors using editable formats assembled from building blocks, with a character style, and MUST flag stale or broken references in preflight. Named text anchors MUST provide hyperlink and cross-reference destinations at exact text positions across documents.
spec_basis.silent: The spec does not state the line of a paragraph with no glyph, what a TOC does with a mapped heading that has no text, or which reason counts when more than one applies. No row decides dropping a whitespace-only heading: it is a declared reading

declared_readings: UNVERIFIED (D5). A mark or destination in a paragraph with no glyph answers the page of that paragraph's blank line, the page compose_with_sentinels gives a marker there

UNVERIFIED (D5). A mapped heading with no text gives no entry: empty, markers with no value only, spaces or other Unicode White_Space only, U+2028 only (kept or not). Basis: an entry with no words and a page number reads as a defect in a TOC and as a blank bookmark in an outline, and one rule replaces three answers (an empty entry with include_overset on, spaces with a label, overset with it off). Behaviour change: a whitespace-only heading was listed with its spaces and a label at both generators, and a placed empty heading was counted overset. InDesign behaviour not known; for the D5 oracle

UNVERIFIED (D5). One reason per heading, first that applies: hidden, overset, no text. The layer removes a heading before its text is read; an overset heading with include_overset off is counted overset, its text unread and no gap reported, as before; with include_overset on, a heading with no text counts no_text, not overset
UNVERIFIED (D5). White space means Unicode White_Space (str::trim): a zero-width space is a character, so a heading of one keeps its entry
A heading on a hidden layer and overset is on no frame, so it counts as overset or no text, not hidden

A blank styled paragraph stays no running-text occurrence: on a running header it would replace the heading before it with nothing. A whitespace-only styled paragraph has glyphs and a line and stays the occurrence it was, so the TOC and running text read it differently. Stated, not changed: running.rs is outside this lane. InDesign UNVERIFIED (D5)
A cross-reference has no hidden rule: a destination on a hidden layer still answers its page, as before for text with glyphs
A destination in an empty paragraph with <fullPara/> resolves to empty text, status as before: not flagged by this lane

The blank lookup reads Line.paragraph as the index of story.paragraphs, as place_markers reads the partition. A story whose paragraphs are not the composition's partition reads its blank line as not placed, typed and counted

notes.behaviour_change: Public: GeneratedStory.omitted, TocOmitted. A placed empty heading moves from omitted_overset to omitted_no_text. A whitespace-only heading moves from an entry to omitted_no_text at both generators, and leaves the outline. A marker-only heading on a hidden layer moves from omitted_no_text to omitted_hidden, and an empty one from omitted_overset to omitted_hidden. A mark or destination on a blank line reads its page, a mark there on a hidden layer counts hidden, not unplaced. After a blank line, a heading, mark, destination or running-text occurrence reads its own page, and text overset right after a placed blank line reads overset. A scoped range ending in a blank paragraph ends there. Tests that held the replaced readings changed, with the reason in each: derived_text.rs an_empty_heading_gives_no_entry_as_the_marker_only_reading_says, white_space_with_no_marker_is_not_this_rule, renamed white_space_with_no_marker_is_this_rule_too because its claim reversed, not to evade anything
